primary_task_salience.evidence: Wall + event rail occupy ~97% of both screenshots with only a 52px chrome bar (index.html:29-31), and the live clock/LIVE/pause apparatus makes the monitoring job unmistakable. Docked because at capture the anomaly channel is empty: chips read 严重0/警告0/正常48 and no tile shows a WARN/CRIT badge at either viewport, so the brief's success object — anomaly visible within a glance — is present only indirectly (red deltas 直播断流 ▲490.5%, 对账滞后 ▲118.0%; historical rail events). Root cause is the inert persistent-incident seeding (see defects_observed).

Detail costs one click on a tile (:424 click→selectMetric) or one click on a rail event row (:634); arrow keys walk the grid (:698-709), '/' focuses search (:690-692), ?select= deep-link supported (:391,:739).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces are one 52px topbar (brand, clock, 4 severity chips, search, pause — index.html:29-63, 164-177) and a 332px side column (:110); the inspector is hidden until a tile is selected (:112, :183 hidden). Every control maps to the monitor job (severity filter, search, pause, event stream); the 48-tile density is demanded by the brief's many/high-density facets rather than being ornament.

accessibility.evidence: Receipt fails all four presentation checks: a11y.contrast=fail, a11y.focus_order=fail, a11y.target_size=fail, type.min_projected_size=fail (measurement-summary.json checks). Visible correlates: 9.5-10px labels (t-badge index.html:99, t-svc :91), low-contrast gray tier --text-3:#5d6b7a on dark tiles (:11, used for units/tags/timestamps), ~29px chip/search/pause targets (:42-56, :59-62). Offsetting semantic effort is real: button tiles with focus-visible ring (:87, :417-419), aria-pressed chips (:52, :673), aria-labels on search/pause/close (:175-176, :186), role=log rail (:204), arrow-key grid navigation (:698-709) — but the objective receipt failures cap the score.

frontend_rework.evidence: No visible layout defects: layout.overflow=pass, layout.responsive_collision=pass, text.truncation=pass (measurement-summary.json), and both screenshots show clean, aligned grids at 1280 and 1440. Rework is implied by the four receipt a11y/type failures plus the functional seeding bug (index.html:322, :349, :363) that suppresses the intended first-screen anomaly content (screenshots: 0/0/48 chips, zero WARN/CRIT badges) — a content-level fix and re-verification, though nothing visually broken.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed 指标变化可追溯: every change emits a timestamped from→to event with kind (index.html:311-315, :626-637), the inspector lists per-metric events new→old with values (:538-550), chart annotates event points with dots + leader lines (:588-597), hover crosshair gives value at any past tick (:607-616). Seed 无闪烁噪声: durable encodings — delta computed vs a 60-tick reference, not the previous tick (:435), FLIP transform-only reorder with no layout thrash (:469-490), filter/search via visibility toggle without DOM rebuild (:493-509), rail prepend preserves scrollTop (:639-647), tabular-nums throughout (:38, :48, :93).

defects_observed: Persistent seed incidents are inert: startIncident sets remaining=1e9 for persistent incidents (index.html:349), so the per-tick pull (target-v)/remaining at :322 is ~0 and the five scripted 首屏常态异常 anomalies (:363-369) never approach their thresholds. Both screenshots corroborate: chips read 严重0/警告0/正常48 with no WARN/CRIT badge or threshold styling on any tile at 1280x860 or 1440x900.

All four receipt presentation checks fail: a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size (measurement-summary.json checks); consistent with visibly small gray type and compact controls in the source.

At capture, large red deltas (直播断流 ▲490.5%, 对账滞后 ▲118.0%, 错误率 ▲56.7% — both screenshots) coexist with 0 severe/0 warn chips and a rail full of 升至警告/恢复正常 history: change-delta and threshold-state semantics are both shown but nothing reconciles them at a glance, so the header reads as self-contradictory on first sight.
scores.overall_note: impl-18 is a purpose-fit representation for monitor × volatile-evidence-stream: a 48-metric status wall (value, unit, direction-aware delta, sparkline) plus a timestamped from→to change-event rail and an in-place inspector with threshold lines, event markers, and a hover readout, all reachable with zero navigation and no context loss. The acceptance seed (changes traceable, no flicker) is addressed by concrete, inspectable mechanisms — a persistent event log with kinds, FLIP transform-only resorting, scrollTop-preserving prepend, and non-rebuilding filters — and all three layout checks pass at both viewports, so the strongest parts of this package are representation and interaction design. Two gaps hold it back: first, all four receipt presentation checks fail (a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size), consistent with the small low-contrast labels and ~29px controls in the source; second, the scripted persistent first-screen anomalies are mathematically inert (remaining=1e9 makes the pull term ~0), so both screenshots capture an all-normal wall (0 severe / 0 warn / 48 normal, no badges) at exactly the moment the brief's success criterion — anomaly visible within a glance — applies, leaving only indirect cues (red deltas, rail history). All judgments here are model-judged from screenshots, source, and the sanitized receipt; no human-preference or task-time data exists in this pilot.
